name: ModelVariant152_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant152_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two textured ribbons trail from the two slot data entries towards spiral targets on the other side, then spinning sparks scatter along each ribbon); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, builds the ribbon points, packs two texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0, 4 while the ribbons run, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-169 and 299 images build it without the work-size printf, so their data names bind 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
